editorial.thesis: A mixed-economy city of about 39,000. Its retail is heavy on banks & atms and grocery & daily needs, and thin on desserts, sweets & ice cream and pharmacy & health retail — and 0% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 0% of Raipur's. 0.0 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.41 in Raipur; 0 of the 51 national brands we track are present.

The mapped economy is close to Raipur's mix. Shares of all mapped places: . Raw counts would mislead because Raipur is mapped more completely (10,835 places against 109), so we compare mix, not counts.
No large under-served zone. No zone combines a large resident base with retail depth below 60% of the city average; the thin spots are small and scattered.
Retail is less concentrated than in Raipur. 23% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Raipur 52%). The largest core is Dantewada (35 places).

The widest brand gaps against Raipur. Apollo Pharmacy 0 outlets vs 27; Domino's 0 outlets vs 23; Café Coffee Day 0 outlets vs 13. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 5 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Raipur, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Dantewada is the only mapped zone, with about 20,000 residents. Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 23% of all commercial places, and Dantewada alone lists 35.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Dantewada holds 0 of the 0 tracked chain outlets.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Dantewada has 8 education places and 1 coaching centres.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. There is no large amber area. The blue cores include Dantewada.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (10,835 places in Raipur against 109 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Raipur; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Raipur, Dantewada's mapped places match the benchmark mix.

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 0 outlets of 0 tracked national brands within 5 km — 0.0 per lakh residents against Raipur's 14.41 (187 outlets of 34 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Raipur are Apollo Pharmacy (0 vs 27); Domino's (0 vs 23); Café Coffee Day (0 vs 13). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Raipur's, so low means thin by Raipur's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 5 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Dantewada's age mix against Raipur: children (0–14) 28.2% vs 29.3%, 15–24 19.1% vs 20.2%, working age 48.2% vs 43.2%, 60+ 4.5% vs 7.4%. Under-25s are 47% of residents.

zones.494449: Reasonably supplied: 35 places for about 20,000 residents (index 121), 0 chain outlets.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 0.9% of mapped places against 4.2% in Raipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.8% of mapped places against 2.2% in Raipur — above its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Sutta Bar, Chai Point, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.0% of mapped places against 0.6% in Raipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.8% of mapped places against 1.3% in Raipur — above its share. No mapped outlet in either city: More, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.0% of mapped places against 1.4% in Raipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 0.0% of mapped places against 6.4% in Raipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio, V-Mart.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 19.3% of mapped places against 8.6% in Raipur — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 0.9% of mapped places against 3.5% in Raipur — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 0.9% of mapped places against 4.0% in Raipur — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
